title: Soldier workflow (campaign discipline)
detail: **End-to-end loop (follow every time):** 1) `campaign_frontier`/`campaign_status` to pick highest-value work; `campaign_claim` the intent. 2) **Before redoing work:** `campaign_recall "<gist>"` + `campaign_kb_search "<keywords>"` and check existing graph/assets — reuse prior facts, don’t duplicate. 3) **Recon → assets:** discover/verify targets; record `campaign_fact` (kinds: host, service, note/loot/vuln/cred as appropriate) and ensure assets exist (insert/list assets). 4) **Assets → intents:** turn confirmed observations into concrete next `campaign_intent`(s) (scoped, timeboxed, with parent/from facts). 5) **Execute → evidence:** run scoped actions (prefer structured output: nmap -oX/-oG, httpx -json, nuclei/ffuf/ferox json, netexec/json where possible); bind proof (traffic/commands/artifacts) to results. 6) **Evidence → findings:** when a vuln is confirmed with evidence, register the finding (and `campaign_fact -k vuln` / link evidence); no speculative findings. 7) **Close out:** `campaign_done` (links result fact) or record failure with reason; unclaim/release as needed. 8) **Feedback:** on success record what worked (reusable intel → hint/transfer); on failure record tried+blocker+next hypothesis as facts/intent. 9) **Hygiene:** `campaign_validate` periodically; keep graph consistent. **Scale:** WIP limits, prioritize buckets, rate-limit fragile/ICS, delta rescans (no blind re-scans). **ICS:** active/read-identify allowed, **NO write/control/actuation**.
